attributes.additional_details: We’re deeply disillusioned with our country’s direction. Under Labour and Andy Burnham, we see biased two-tier policing, uncontrolled illegal immigration, and foreign aid prioritised over British needs. Our borders, sovereignty and communities are being undermined. This government has lost public confidence. We demand an immediate general election so the British people can choose a government that puts our nation first, defends our borders and serves its citizens.
attributes.background: We’re fed up with Labour & Andy Burnham. Biased two-tier policing, uncontrolled illegal immigration, foreign aid over British needs. Our sovereignty & borders ignored. This gov. has lost. Demand immediate general election — let the British people choose a government that puts our nation first.
